Game Overview

At its heart, Adventure of Ella is a shooter game about guide Ella in an endless chase as she dashes and blasts piggy zombies. Keep an eye on her health and test your skills to achieve an impressive high score. Jump, shoot, and enjoy the lively pursuit that promises excitement at every leap and shot.
